headline: An open-model launch reshaped the week while several incumbents held position
summary: Moonshot made the clearest verified move. Most other tracked labs had no sourced flagship change, and several positions remain deliberately unclear.

top_moves.summary: Moonshot launched Kimi K3 and moved into the week's central frontier-model conversation.
Google DeepMind's governance proposals remained strategically important without constituting a new flagship release.

under_the_radar.summary: Availability and pricing may matter as much as benchmark leadership when developers choose among frontier models.

next_week: Watch for independent Kimi K3 evaluations rather than relying only on launch benchmarks.
Watch whether other tracked labs answer with pricing, availability, or model updates.
Watch whether open-weight availability changes real developer adoption.
